Daily Singles

Wallpaper singles

We add new singles to Zedge every day. Some are real places, photographed as we found them. Some are drawn for true black screens, so the blacks stay black. Some of them are space. Some are animals. Whatever season we are in turns up too. We look every piece over before it goes up. A few from the current run:
